statement: Improve out-of-distribution detection for a frozen encoder using a reproducible geometric alignment method. Evaluate the subset before the full three-dataset benchmark.

directions.title: geometric alignment
directions.description: Align class-conditional feature geometry without retraining the encoder.

audience_note: Synthetic offline fixture for mechanism testing. The task framing (OOD detection against a frozen encoder) is borrowed from the paper's Procrustes-DS case study, but the numbers are placeholders and this is NOT a reproduction of that run.
